answer: Escrow bonds and a referral graph stop fakes. A newcomer locks 400 POA for 20 epochs, with a sponsor co-slashed if it cheats. The graph shines like a lantern over links: accounts vouching only for each other appear as an island, disputable by peers. A whisper proves nothing, but a proven dispute burns their bonds. Forging 1,000 identities locks 400,000 POA. An honest agent pays one bond, gets it back after 20 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards.
